en: Black-and-white image of a large brick Gothic Revival church with a tall central steeple topped by a cross. The facade features pointed-arch doorways, lancet windows, and a circular rose window above the main entrance. The church occupies a street corner with early-20th‑century houses visible nearby and unpaved or minimally developed streets in the foreground. The image is framed with a white border, resembling an old photographic postcard.
